title: UI风格#53 - Botanical Illustration (植物学插画)
description: 创建第53种UI风格：植物学插画风格 - 古典植物学、细腻线条、科学手绘。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planBA.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Botanical Illustration style When color palette Then features aged paper, botanical greens, sepia, hand-drawn tones
Given Botanical Illustration style When typography Then uses scientific fonts: EB Garamond, Libre Baskerville, or Spectral
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: EB Garamond (headers 3rem italic), Libre Baskerville (body 0.95rem)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Botanical Illustration style When layout Then specimen plates, botanical borders, scientific notation
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: dashed inner borders, botanical borders top/bottom (repeating gradient), aged paper texture overlay, floral divider with ❦ symbol

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Botanical Illustration style When UI elements Then hand-drawn lines, specimen labels, aged textures
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: dashed borders, dotted stat rows, paper texture SVG filter, hover lift with shadow, italic headers

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Botanical Illustration UI When functional Then includes herbarium chat, botanist agents, specimen stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: herbarium chat, 4 botanist cards (Linnaeus/Darwin/Mendel/Hawthorne) with Specimens/Classification/Species/Evolution/Sprints/Hybrid/Tests/Purity stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Botanical Illustration UI When copy Then uses scientific latin: 'Specimen', 'Genus', 'Flora', 'Classis'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'SPECIMEN. GENUS. FLORA.', tagline 'A garden of knowledge', button 'CATALOG', greeting 'Welcome to the Royal Botanical Archive', status 'Cataloging'/'Dormant', nav 'Archive'/'Workbench'
